Title: Tangle Atropos' Hand and actions provided by cards on table

Messages.Author: Mr_Wyrm (AKA Pentex)
Messages.Body:
i cannot find any information about this situation:

arika has a haven uncovered played on her.
koko takes the action provided by HU to enter combat with arika
a procurer attemp to block and koko plays Tangle Atropos' Hand to
cancel the action.

could koko takes again the action to enter combat provides by the same
HU?

thanks!

Tangle Atropos' Hand
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Temporis/Potence
Cost: 1 blood
Only usable when a minion is attempting to block.
[pot] Cancel the action and untap the acting minion. (The blocking
minion is not tapped.)
[tem] As [pot] above, and take the action card, if any, back into your
hand (discard afterward).
[TEM] As [tem] above, and this vampire gets +1 stealth on his or her
next action this turn.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

Yes. The previous action didn't reach resolution, so it doesn't count.
